snippet.title: Double Dragon III: The Sacred Stones (1991 / NES / PS4) - Complete 1P Play
snippet.description: This game is ridiculously difficult - if Jimmy dies once, it's game over, no checkpoints. Transitioning to a new screen does not regenerate your health like in the other two games. There are death pits. There are traps which you spawn on top of. It's dumb. Also, very long. The only cool thing is the other two characters you recruit, but I didn't even notice you can switch to them (essentially getting more than one life bar) until Mission 3!
